shared_elements: animal forms rendered in stone relief/sculpture
stylized rendering of body surface with repeated parallel grooves (drapery/feather ridges)
justification: A shows a multi-register procession of human figures in low relief with a tree and animals, arranged in horizontal bands; B is a single free-standing sculpted raptor-like bird with hooked beak, folded wings and clawed feet, with no scene or companions. The only overlap is the generic presence of animate creatures and repeated parallel grooving used to render surface texture (pleated garments in A, feathers in B), which is far too generic to indicate a shared iconographic scheme.
